name: counter4
title: Coal-COUNTER4 — 4-bit up/down counter
description: Build a 4-bit synchronous up/down counter with enable and asynchronous reset. updown=1 counts up, 0 counts down; en gates counting; carry flags rollover. Testbench prints counter4:PASS.
context: Synchronous to posedge clk. rst is async active-high reset to 0. q is 4-bit. carry=1 when q wraps (7->8 up or 0->15 down). Testbench: reset, then in en=1 updown=1 clock through 0,1,2 and CHECK q; then down from 0 -> 15. print counter4:PASS.

manifest.purpose: 4-bit up/down counter with enable and carry
manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input en, input updown, output reg [3:0] q, output reg carry
manifest.behavior: after reset q=0; with en=1 updown=1, one posedge -> q=1, next -> q=2; with updown=0 from q=0 -> q=15. print counter4:PASS if values match.
